7`) (11) straight -> lane_change_urban: label `dist_to_front<15 && extra_lane=true`, required guard 'dist_to_front<15 and extra_lane=true' (PlantUML line 27: `straight --> lane_change_urban : dist_to_front<15 && extra_lane=true`) (12) collision_avoidance_deactive -> collision_avoidance_active: label `pedestrian_detected || (dist_to_rear<5 && vel>30) || (dist_to_front<15 && in(HighwayMode)) || (dist_to_front<10 && in(UrbanMode))`, required guard 'pedestrian_detected OR (dist_to_rear<5 AND vel>30) OR (front_dist<15 in highway mode OR front_dist<10 in urban mode)' (PlantUML line 39: `collision_avoidance_deactive --> collision_avoidance_active : pedestrian_detected || (dist_to_rear<5 && vel>30) || (dist_to_front<15 && in(HighwayMode)) || (dist_to_front<10 && in(UrbanMode))`) (13) collision_avoidance_active -> collision_avoidance_deactive: label `front_inactive && rear_inactive && pedestrian_inactive`, required guard 'front_inactive AND rear_inactive AND pedestrian_inactive' (PlantUML line 40: `collision_avoidance_active --> collision_avoidance_deactive : front_inactive && rear_inactive && pedestrian_inactive`) In PlantUML a label without brackets is the trigger;

field_audits.exact_text:
FinishState has no explicit declaration. Its first mention is PlantUML line 13: `lane_change --> FinishState : dist_to_exit<2` inside the HighwayMode block, so PlantUML declares it as a child of HighwayMode. It is also used from outside that block: PlantUML line 28: `straight --> FinishState : auto_finished=true`; PlantUML line 30: `intersection --> FinishState : auto_finished=true`; PlantUML line 43: `AutonomousMode --> FinishState : auto_finished=true`. In the closed model those transitions enter HighwayMode and are routed to its child FinishState.

Consequences observed in the same closed model (folded sub-claims, each an obligation settled by this root cause): (1) HighwayMode termination at FinishState not completed from enter_hwy and lane_change on auto_finished_true: From cruise, auto_finished_true has two options: transition to FinishState (line 32) OR exit HighwayMode directly (line 38). From enter_hwy, auto_finished_true exits HighwayMode directly (line 37) without reaching FinishState. From lane_change, auto_finished_true exits HighwayMode directly (line 39) without reaching FinishState. In three of four HighwayMode substates (enter_hwy, lane_change, and one path from cruise), the auto_finished_true trigger leads to mode exit rather than termination at FinishState.
